description: Policy presets and review gates for the Media Intelligence Workbench Skill Tool. Gates are data, not code: the planner attaches the gates listed on each catalog skill and the workbench refuses to mark a deliverable 'release-ready' while a mandatory gate is unsatisfied.

draft.summary: Internal exploration only. Lowest friction, still non-destructive.
draft.notes: No output may be labelled publication-ready; every deliverable carries a draft banner.

standard.summary: Default for production research, reporting and review workflows.
standard.notes: Any finding routed to a forensic, safety, clinical or governance decision requires a named human reviewer.

conservative.notes: Escalate early and often. No affected-person, employment, education, housing, lending, health or legal decision may rest on this tool's output.

gate-ingestion-safety.title: Ingestion safety screen
gate-ingestion-safety.required_action: Run `inspect` (safety scan) before any decode. Block on verdict=block and surface the findings with byte offsets.

gate-evidence-check.title: Evidence completeness check
gate-evidence-check.trigger: Any claim produced by an analysis unit.
gate-evidence-check.required_action: Each claim must carry a source file plus a timecode, region, span or byte offset. Unsupported statements must be marked as inference.

gate-human-review-on-low-confidence.title: Low-confidence human review
gate-human-review-on-low-confidence.trigger: Unit confidence below the preset review threshold, or any abstention.
gate-human-review-on-low-confidence.required_action: Route the case to a reviewer with the evidence bundle and the specific unanswered question.

gate-accessibility-review.title: Accessibility review
gate-accessibility-review.trigger: Caption, description, contrast, flashing or sign-language deliverables.
gate-accessibility-review.required_action: A human checks reading speed, line breaks, obstruction and flash thresholds against the published criteria; automated metrics are aids only.

gate-non-destructive.title: Non-destructive processing
gate-non-destructive.required_action: Write to a new output path, keep the original read-only, record parameters and a recipe id so the operation can be reproduced or rolled back.

gate-approval-before-write.title: Approval before writing outputs
gate-approval-before-write.trigger: Any command that creates, rewrites or deletes files.
gate-approval-before-write.required_action: The caller must pass `--approve` (interactive terminals get a prompt; non-interactive runs are refused).

gate-privacy-review.title: Privacy review
gate-privacy-review.trigger: Media containing people, voices, plates, screens, documents or location cues.
gate-privacy-review.required_action: Decide redaction scope, aggregate-only reporting and retention before outputs leave the workspace.

gate-approval-before-publish.title: Publication approval
gate-approval-before-publish.trigger: Any release, publication, external distribution or rights-affecting use.
gate-approval-before-publish.required_action: Named human sign-off after consent, rights, redaction persistence and accessibility checks.

gate-evidence-preservation.title: Forensic evidence preservation
gate-evidence-preservation.required_action: Hash originals, keep read-only copies, record chain-of-custody entries and never analyse a modified original.

gate-forensic-review.title: Forensic finding review
gate-forensic-review.trigger: Any manipulation, splice or provenance conclusion.
gate-forensic-review.required_action: Second-qualified-reviewer pass that argues alternative explanations, compression effects and tool limits; no certainty claims.

gate-no-autonomous-action.title: No autonomous consequential action
gate-no-autonomous-action.trigger: Safety, security, clinical or enforcement contexts.
gate-no-autonomous-action.required_action: Outputs are advisory only. Do not dispatch, enforce, diagnose, deny or discipline on the basis of media analysis alone.

gate-escalation.title: Escalation path
gate-escalation.trigger: Urgent audible or visible cues (alarms, smoke, distress, crashes).
gate-escalation.required_action: Confirm with corroborating cues or certified sensors; escalate to the responsible human channel and log the alert with timestamps.

gate-clinical-review.title: Clinical review
gate-clinical-review.required_action: Qualified clinician reviews acquisition quality and any observation; the workbench never issues a diagnosis.

gate-checkpoint.title: Checkpoint and resume
gate-checkpoint.required_action: Persist stage status, hashes and parameters so a restart does not repeat completed work.

gate-reproducibility.title: Reproducibility
gate-reproducibility.required_action: Record tool versions, parameters, seeds, input fingerprints and metric definitions with the result.

gate-audit-trail.title: Audit trail
gate-audit-trail.required_action: Append-only log of source, consent, tools, parameters, reviewers, outputs and decisions.

abstention_rules: If a required input (e.g. a reliable scale reference, a calibrated thermal frame, a consent record) is absent, the unit must abstain and state the missing input rather than estimate.
Absent provenance metadata is not evidence of manipulation; absence must be reported as 'not available'.
Never convert a visual or acoustic observation into an identity, diagnosis, intent, guilt or protected-trait inference.
Do not report a measurement outside the validated range of the metric; state the tolerance or the reason for abstaining.
